Treston International College officially opened School Year 2025–2026 with a lively and spirited Welcome Rally held at the Multipurpose Hall last August 19, 2025. The event began with a vibrant parade of students, filling the venue with energy and excitement as the Treston community reunited and welcomed new members.

The program began with inspiring welcome remarks from Dr. Francis Tolentino, School Head of the School of Business, who encouraged students to make the most of the opportunities at Treston. Adding to the celebration, selected students: Pinoy Big Brother Celebrity Collab  Edition Big 4 AZ Martinez, Miss Philippines Earth 2021 Naelah Alshorbaji Almazik, and Mr. Treston 2024 Jinhyun Kim, along with alumni Shyla Ramos, Summa Cum Laude, Class of 2021, and Jodel Cortes, Summa Cum Laude, Class of 2025, shared their personal Treston journeys, highlighting the valuable experiences and lessons that shaped their academic and personal growth.

The rally was also brought to life by special performances from senior high school student and Eat Bulaga host Carren Eistrup Frederiksen and the Treston Dance Company, showcasing talent and artistry that captivated the audience. Students enthusiastically joined fun games that fostered camaraderie and school spirit, while various club booths set up at the Bar and Dining Hall introduced the wide range of student organizations and opportunities available on campus.

The Welcome Rally set the tone for a vibrant, purposeful, and exciting school year ahead—one filled with learning, collaboration, and meaningful experiences for every Golden Lion.

#weareTreston #WeRoar #GoldenLions
